name: go-annotations
description: Highlights Go struct tags, declaration doc comments and Kubebuilder markers, on top of gopls semantic highlighting.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace controller-gen is not run, so marker names are split using the built-in marker list.

goAnnotations.comments.useColors.markdownDescription: Colour doc comment names and markers with the `goAnnotations.*` theme colours. Off by default: they keep the theme's comment colour and are told apart by weight and style only (names bold, marker arguments italic).

goAnnotations.structTags.enabled.description: Highlight keys, names and options inside struct tags.

goAnnotations.docComments.enabled.description: Embolden the documented name (the struct, field, function, ... it is about) inside doc comments.

goAnnotations.markers.enabled.description: Highlight controller-gen / Kubebuilder marker comments such as // +kubebuilder:validation:Minimum=1.

goAnnotations.markers.controllerGenPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `controller-gen` binary whose markers are used to tell a marker name from its first argument. Relative paths resolve against each workspace folder. When empty, `bin/controller-gen` in a workspace folder (where Kubebuilder's Makefile installs it) and then `controller-gen` on `PATH` are tried; failing those, a built-in copy of controller-gen's markers is used.

colors.description: Struct tag key, e.g. json in json:"name,omitempty".
Struct tag value name, e.g. name in json:"name,omitempty".
Struct tag option, e.g. omitempty in json:"name,omitempty".
Documented name inside a doc comment, e.g. Dataset in // Dataset is ... (used when goAnnotations.comments.useColors is on).
The + that opens a marker comment (used when goAnnotations.comments.useColors is on).
Marker name, e.g. kubebuilder:validation:Minimum (used when goAnnotations.comments.useColors is on).
Named marker argument, e.g. type in +kubebuilder:printcolumn:type=string (used when goAnnotations.comments.useColors is on).
Marker argument value (used when goAnnotations.comments.useColors is on).

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
